suggestions.reason: A hand-edited decisions.md with the right words would also pass this assertion and the guide-refreshed mechanical check. The discriminating test — re-running render_guide.py over the patched workspace and asserting a zero diff on guide/ — is cheap and mechanical; consider promoting it into the assertion or the pre-checks.

No assertion pins WO-002's post-unblock ledger status to a specific value. 'status no longer awaiting_ruling' would pass for 'done' or 'in_progress' too; if the skill's ledger vocabulary mandates 'pending' after unblocking, assert that exact value.

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions are well-chosen and discriminating overall — the surgical-patch assertion in particular is hard to satisfy without genuinely doing the work. The two gaps above are minor tightening opportunities.
